about:
Holm Made Toffee Co. is a family- and women-owned artisan confectioner based in Bend, Oregon. The company operates a production kitchen at 1234 NE 1st Street, where it crafts candy in traditional handmade batches using Oregon-grown hazelnuts and ingredients sourced from the Pacific Northwest.

The product line centers on hazelnut toffee, offered in assorted flavors and seasonal varieties such as Candy Cane and Gingerbread, alongside gift sets and branded merchandise. Production occurs in a dedicated kitchen that also opens for in-person shopping Tuesday through Thursday, 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. The company sells directly to consumers through its online shop and supplies wholesale accounts.

Customers include retail shoppers seeking gluten-free, soy-free, and corn-syrup-free treats, as well as wholesale buyers looking for artisan confectionery. The brand emphasizes local sourcing and a simple ingredient deck, positioning its toffee as a Pacific Northwest specialty gift item.

The founders frame the business around a promise of "happiness, plain and simple," highlighting the absence of common allergens and the use of regional ingredients as key differentiators. The women-owned, family-run structure underscores a commitment to small-batch quality and community-focused production.
